articles.summary: LEOMINSTER, MA – September 20, 2026 – Despite rainy weather, more than 110 children and their families from across Central Massachusetts and Middlesex County gathered at Leominster DekHockey for Assists For Kids: Hockey Is For Everyone, a special event hosted by Avidia Bank and featuring NHL Hall of Famer and Boston Bruins legend Patrice Bergeron. articles.title: Avidia Bank, Patrice Bergeron and Franklin Sports Bring Dek Hockey Experience to Local Kids
